target_semantics_lesson: Forecast United States monthly retail-sales growth for September 2024.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate the purchasing power checkpoint with agreement between labor conditions and real income indicators. Contradictions arise if employment weakens or inflation erodes income.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Stable purchasing power supports consumer demand. Employment acts as a mediator. However, category mix strength may not signal broad retail growth.
counterevidence_lesson: Historical data shows September can be a weak month for retail sales, contrasting with recent strength in March.
calibration_lesson: Assess if category strength is broad or concentrated. Reconcile aggregate retail data with household demand and employment evidence to calibrate confidence.
